comment: Kept by the lead session. This is the lead's record of work that has not landed yet, not a measured fact.

items.name: Animation and interaction check
items.brief: Build scripts/check-motion.mjs: filmstrips through each animation and every hover, click, toggle, slider, drag and scroll; flag flicker, pass-through, depth flips, dead controls and misaligned hit areas. Fix book and bookshelf.

items.name: Batch L: last charts
items.brief: Convert stackbars, funnel, waterfall, treemap, radar, activity; remove every px written from JS.

items.name: Text review
items.brief: Compare every converted model's how-it-works steps, description, ingredient chips and tags against its current code; fix text only.

items.name: Redesigns the ruler could not fix
items.brief: textring: fewer, larger characters plus a steeper tilt to clear the 40vmin floor. layertext: restack onto two lines. Bring up rings and dotorbit. Check whether waveletters' paused first frame shows letters mid-flip.

items.name: Verify gate
items.brief: npm run verify: every check over every model, sharded; paused to keep the laptop cool.

items.brief: Every image and video setting, measured through editing, the dialog canvas, the preview and the saved file; a lead agent re-checks the workers.
